claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition M-03 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F07; type EXPLICIT; BIOCHEMICAL/PHYSIOLOGICAL; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: INDIRECT / MECHANISTIC ONLY; required mechanism state: INDIRECTLY SUPPORTED. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_scope: PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN | SURROGATE ENDPOINT ONLY
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.claim_text: That process reduces oxidative stress in humans.
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: Markers scattered and multiply tested; no prespecification
No mediation from electrical exposure to oxidative change
Depends on M-01b (NOT ESTABLISHED) and M-02 (SPECULATIVE)

evidence_items.text: Chevalier et al. 2018: selected oxidative and inflammatory markers changed in a 16-participant massage-therapist stepped-wedge design.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The nearest human oxidative-marker evidence; small, many markers, no continuous parallel control, and one dataset with H22.

evidence_items.text: Non-human and ex-vivo oxidative signals, including the Giulivi & Kotz 2025 mitochondrial ROS reduction.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Directionally consistent but not human and not in vivo.

evidence_items.text: No prespecified human oxidative-stress endpoint with mediation from electrical exposure was located; the causal electron mediation is absent.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Marker movement without mediation cannot establish that the claimed process is the cause.

evidence_items.text: Lin et al. 2022 reported the proposed electrochemical signal as non-supportive.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: Human marker evidence exists but is small, multiply tested and unmediated; it cannot attribute change to the specific claimed process.

detected.rationale: A preclinical antioxidant pathway is credited with human oxidative-stress reduction that scattered marker movement does not causally establish.
No study mediates from electrical exposure through electron delivery and radical neutralisation to a human oxidative-stress endpoint.

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Purchase of a wellness device on antioxidant grounds.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That the advertised electron mechanism has been shown to lower oxidative stress in people.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Oxidative-stress reduction is the pivot from mechanism to the advertised therapeutic list.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: overclaim is a genuine competing reading and is recorded as the documented alternative. mechanism_vs_evidence is primary because the operative error is the attribution of scattered human marker movement to a specific unestablished preclinical pathway.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL — Steelman established genuine indirect marker support; the adversarial layer showed the process-specific attribution fails. Resolved by verdicting the exact wording while recording the surviving marker-level support.
missing_evidence: Markers scattered and multiply tested; no prespecification
No mediation from electrical exposure to oxidative change
Depends on M-01b (NOT ESTABLISHED) and M-02 (SPECULATIVE)
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: Prespecified human oxidative-stress endpoints with electrical-exposure mediation have not been studied.

verdict.verdict_summary: Some human oxidative and inflammatory markers have moved in grounding studies, and the mechanism layer is frozen as INDIRECTLY SUPPORTED. The proposition as worded, however, attributes that reduction to 'that process' — the electron delivery and radical neutralisation of M-01b and M-02, which are NOT ESTABLISHED and SPECULATIVE. No study mediates from electrical exposure to oxidative-stress change.
